summary_1line: Gods defeat the Asuras with Narayana’s discus; afterward Kadru and Vinata wager over Uchchaihsravas, leading Kadru to curse her serpent sons.

image_candidates.scene_text: Narayana hurls the blazing Sudarsana discus, which whirls across the sky cutting down thousands of Daityas like a spinning sun of fire.
Danavas in the sky hurl entire mountains with forests attached down upon the gods as the earth trembles beneath the falling peaks.
Kadru commands her thousand serpent sons to become black hairs and secretly cover the white horse Uchchaihsravas’ tail.
